cohort: The study included 26 GDM-mothers and 34 non-GDM mothers of Caucasian origin and their neonates admitted to a gynecology and obstetrics department of a university hospital.
finding: Placental sclerostin and LRP5 were significantly greater in GDM compared with non-GDM placentas, and placental sclerostin values were positively associated with pregestational maternal body mass index and maternal fasting glucose concentrations.
cross-section timing: Placental and umbilical serum samples were collected at birth, and maternal fasting glucose data was retrieved from 24-28 weeks of gestation.
